subject: Classify four Cyrdach deployment-zone MoveOk-to-MoveWaiting controls
description: COMPLETED AS SOURCE-VERIFIED NO-FIX. Four retained schema-12 Cyrdach controls first diverge when Rust's Sherwood deployment-zone script interrupts PC creation-order 89 (Rust Pc108) with RecordMove to location 10 while the archived Original trace retains its existing MoveOk. The controls are Profile_156 Savegame_010/replay-001 (frame 1126), Savegame_015/replay-009 (frame 1976), Savegame_023/replay-009 (frame 1876), and Savegame_023/replay-011 (frame 1826). Rust adds the PC to script zone 14 after its ordinary movement crosses the authored edge (1771,648.00037)->(1526,375.00034); StartUp.Hourglass later sees four occupants instead of the three mission-team PCs and CheckDeploymentZone records the move. This is not a containment implementation defect: both Rust and the exact FLOAT arithmetic of SBGeoPolygon2DArray::IsInside classify old (1546.740845,400.692596) outside and new (1549.510132,399.538757) inside. It is not a crossing-test defect either: the Original SBGeoSegment2D::IsIntersecting determinants are +632.35547 and -406.35156 for the script edge against the movement endpoints, with the reciprocal pair -943.62518 and -95.08084; the old-position-on-line determinant is nonzero. The trace records IsMovingMap=true, layer 0, upright/not-carried movement, and an in-map endpoint, while the line is an active associated LINE_SCRIPT edge. Current RHelementactor.cpp CheckForLineCrossing therefore necessarily retrieves and dispatches this edge, and RHsector.cpp then enters zone 14. Disabling the schema-12 beam-PC identity remap was also A/B tested and left the divergence identical. The rejected workaround was to suppress runtime crossings by RHSectorScript::IsReallyInside layer/motion-sector topology: that predicate belongs only to bulk initialization and post-flight reconstruction in the Original; ordinary line crossing intentionally performs polygon containment only. No source-backed Rust change can reproduce these historical recordings. The controls must be re-recorded with the current Original build/assets before they can be authoritative; no gameplay code was changed.
resolution: Archived as historical schema-12 recordings inconsistent with the current Original source. Exact polygon and segment arithmetic require the zone entry that the traces omit; source-wrong suppression guards were rejected.
